# Arcturus Professional Services

Arcturus Professional Services is the independent solo freelance practice of Khushboo Tomar. Khushboo is based in New Delhi, India and works directly with businesses in Ireland, the United Kingdom and wider Europe. All communication is in writing by email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn. Phone calls and call-booking appointments are not offered.

## Services (all prices in EUR)

- LinkedIn Management: profile optimisation, content, targeted outreach, follow-ups and written reporting. EUR 400 per month. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/linkedin-management
- B2B Email Outreach: GDPR and PECR-aware cold email campaigns with a one-month domain warm-up, follow-ups and reporting. EUR 500 per month. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/email-outreach
- Business Support: remote research, administration, documents, website support and AI-assisted content. EUR 30 per hour, billed on actual time. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/business-support
- Lead Generation: verified B2B contact research by company size, role, industry and location. EUR 250 per 100 verified contacts. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/lead-generation
- AI Video Creation: custom AI-generated short videos and reels with branding, logo and end cards. EUR 400 per month. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/ai-video-creation
- Email Setup: business email and DNS configuration including SPF, DKIM and DMARC. EUR 200 one-time. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/email-setup

## Payment

50% in advance before work starts, remaining 50% on delivery. Monthly services: 50% at the start and 50% at the end of each month. Payments via Wise. Third-party subscriptions (Sales Navigator, Hootsuite, domains, email accounts) are paid by the client.
